title: Practice: split one oversized memory file into a root file, scoped rules and personal files (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the conventions of each area load for exactly the files that area governs
cases.says: Seven touched files each bring in exactly the right conventions, and the root rules every time

cases.id: e1 the root file is short and holds only what every task needs
cases.says: The root file is at most 50 lines, keeps the universal rules and carries no area convention, not even through an import

cases.id: e2 the testing rule follows the file type and not the folder
cases.says: The testing rule covers test files in three different folders and no other file

cases.id: e3 the import names a file that exists and loads at launch
cases.says: The import names a file that exists and is expanded

cases.id: e4 personal lines sit in personal files and the local file is ignored
cases.says: Personal lines are in the personal files, absent from shared ones, and CLAUDE.local.md is ignored

cases.id: e5 a rule that must always hold is a permission rule and not a sentence
cases.says: Edits under db/migrations/ are denied and other edits are not

cases.id: e6 every rule scopes itself with paths that are valid and match something
cases.says: Every rule has a list of valid paths, and each pattern matches a file

cases.id: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address or a key
